change.scope: saturated 512-slot decode in all 36 SWA layers
change.shape: 72 query heads, 8 KV heads, D128, capacity/window/scan 512
change.geometry: 40 local256 workgroups and 320 wave32s per layer; five owners per KV head carry query-head pairs, with the fifth owner carrying the ninth head alone
change.arithmetic: unchanged wave32 QK reduction tree, scalar slot-order maximum/exponent/denominator, per-dimension FMA sequence, divide, softplus gate, F32 store, and RNE-BF16 store
change.optimization: fuse exact QK, softmax, PV, and gate into one workgroup-local score/physical plane; reuse each BF16 K vector across two adjacent query heads and eliminate the global score plane plus one launch
change.fallback: live counts below 512, non-natural shapes, peer backends, and explicit capability rollback retain the exact GQA3 score plus fixed512 reducer route

red_green.red: focused registration gate failed because the fused GQA2 variant was absent
red_green.green: live 512 plus ring wrap and explicit eviction are F32/BF16 byte-exact against retained production
red_green.focused_result: initial broad focused bundle had one isolated compile failure after candidate cleanup; adding the accidentally removed extern C int declaration repaired the only failing node, then the full changed attention test file plus runtime selector passed 3/3 while the original broad run had established all other nodes green
